issues.description: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET falls back to a hardcoded default 'dev-secret-change-in-production' with no production guard. Better Auth uses this secret to sign sessions and OAuth state; a predictable default in production enables forgeable tokens. Diverges from the codebase's own CSRF_SECRET pattern (middleware/csrf.ts:10-17) which throws when unset in NODE_ENV=production. Value is plan-mandated (spec-compliant), so this is a security hardening note, not a spec violation; recommend a production guard.

getGitHubPrimaryEmail is exported and unit-tested but never called in the production path. The actual GitHub no-verified-email abort (DELIVERABLE scenario 2) is enforced by mapProfileToUser plus Better Auth's internal /user/emails fetch, so the tested function is not the live guard. Either wire it into the guard or note it as an intentionally-extracted pure helper.
